objective: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

description: <The text on this note is made up of various typefaces glued onto the parchment's surface.>
We've got your precious book, gnome. If you ever want to see it again, you'll do exactly as we ask.
<A detailed set of instructions is listed, spanning 3 pages.>
Bring the money and come alone!
completion: Booknap my... book, will they!? I'll teach them what it means to mess with a psychic gnome!
